key_insight: CausalForge couples Lean-verified formalization with an agentic research loop to make automated causal-inference theory generation both more productive and more trustworthy.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical blueprint for building autonomous theorem-proving systems where generated claims are checked by proof assistants and audited against their intended informal meaning.
method: Causalean: a Lean causal-inference library with 7,035 machine-checked declarations
CausalSmith: a self-improving pipeline that selects topics, proposes results, formalizes statements, and constructs proofs
Statement audit: compares each formal theorem to the informal claim before human inspection
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on artifacts from completed autonomous research runs, with source code, the formal library, and run records publicly released.
watch_item: Kernel verification alone does not guarantee scientific validity, since a formally correct theorem may still misstate the intended causal claim.
paper_title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
